articles.title: As China-US space race heats up, Shanghai unveils space-computing hub
articles.summary: Shanghai's launch of a new space-computing hub marks a significant escalation in China's efforts to establish a robust orbital data ecosystem, positioning the city as a critical player in the intensifying China-US space race and highlighting the growing importance of integrated technologies in commercial space endeavors.

articles.title: China’s AI chip drive: MetaX and Iluvatar swing to profit, as Biren narrows losses
articles.summary: China's AI chip industry is witnessing a significant transformation as companies like MetaX and Iluvatar achieve profitability amid a government push for self-reliance, highlighting a critical shift that could reshape the global semiconductor landscape and enhance China's technological independence. This emerging success contrasts sharply with other players still grappling with losses, underscoring the competitive dynamics within the sector.
